summary.intent: Run the GSD (plan→execute) workflow for Phase 68 gap closure (ROT-07 fail-closed rotation gate + folderTree staleness) in the cipher-box repo, then verify the fix with the full local web-e2e suite rather than accepting SDK-unit-only proof.
summary.outcome: Phase 68 gap closure (68-11, 68-12) was planned, verified, and executed successfully with all SDK-tier tests green, but running the full web-e2e suite locally revealed the v2.0 web app's read+write chain is 46 stubs deep ("not implemented — phase 63/65"), unrelated to Phase 68 but blocking any green e2e run; a new Phase 68.1 ("Web Client Runtime Integration") was scoped and scaffolded (ROADMAP/REQUIREMENTS/RESEARCH/CONTEXT) to wire the existing sdk-core read+write primitives into the web app, with full web-e2e-green as its exit gate.

repo: packages/sdk/src/client.ts's ensureFolderLoaded (originally named in 68-VERIFICATION.md as the fail-closed gate target) is dead phase-63 stub code that throws 'not implemented'; the real live chokepoint is reconcileFolderSequence (client.ts:518-ish), called before every rename/delete/deleteToBin/move

packages/sdk/src/client.ts rotateReadFromNode discarded the root's rotated {readKey,generation,sequenceNumber} behind a void return; its only production caller is performScopeExitRotation (client.ts:569), so changing it to return RotateReadResult|undefined is backward-compatible

The web app (apps/web) and packages/sdk/client.ts contain 17 'not implemented — phase 63' stubs (read-chain: root Node init, navigation/ensureFolderLoaded, createFolder, file metadata/download/preview/streaming, shared-folder nav) introduced in commit b2dba554a (Phase 62, 2026-06-29), predating Phase 68

There are also 29 'not implemented — phase 65' stubs (write-chain: owned file create/replace/versions, bin subtree re-link, share/invite creation, shared-folder write op wrappers) — 46 total runtime stubs; nearly all web-e2e specs create/upload/share content before reading it, so read-chain wiring alone cannot make the suite green

packages/core/src/node/ Node codec (sealNode/unsealNode/sealChildReadKey/sealChildWriteKey/sealContent) is fully implemented and complete; packages/sdk/src/share/shared-write.ts (~920 LOC) implements the full shared read+write chain and is the canonical reference to copy for owned-path wiring

Owned FolderState (sdk types.ts:164) is read-chain-only (no writeKey/publishedNode) while SharedFolderState (types.ts:205) carries the full write-body model — this divergence blocks a clean copy of shared-write.ts patterns for owned file create/update and is a real architecture decision the new phase's planner must resolve
SealedChildRef has no 'kind' field (frozen schema), so file-vs-folder discrimination (isFileRef/isFilePointer) requires either a network hop per child or a caching/design decision

Some client.ts comments claiming ops are 'stubbed in shared-write.ts' are stale — updateSharedFile and moveInSharedFolder are fully implemented in shared-write.ts; only the client.ts wrappers and web hooks are stubbed

Playwright's webServer in tests/web-e2e auto-starts mock-IPNS-routing (:3001), API dev (:3000), and web dev (:5173); externally required: Postgres (:5432), Kubo (:5001/:8080 CORS), Redis (:6379/6380), built packages, built mock-ipns-routing, playwright chromium browser, correct .env files
apps/api uses TypeORM with migrationsRun:true (synchronize off) on `nest start --watch`, so a fresh dev-server start auto-applies migrations — no manual migration step needed

gsd-tools has a 'phase insert'/'phase add' subcommand and 'next-decimal' that cleanly inserts a decimal phase (e.g. 68.1) between existing phases without renumbering later phases — safer than hand-editing ROADMAP.md

code.finding: ensureFolderLoaded throws 'not implemented — phase 63' (confirmed dead code), while reconcileFolderSequence (line 518) is the real live pre-mutation resolve gate called before renameItem/moveItem/deleteItem/deleteToBin (5 call sites)
performScopeExitRotation's only caller of rotateReadFromNode; discarded rootResult needed to refresh folderTree after scope-exit rotation (Gap 2 fix target)
createFileMetadata (owned file write-chain) is stubbed/throws — root blocker for owned file upload; uploadFile in upload/index.ts:168 calls it and breaks at runtime despite itself being implemented
updateFileMetadata (owned file update/versions) is stubbed/throws — root blocker for owned replace/version features
uploadToSharedFolder is the canonical reference implementation to copy for building the missing owned-file write-chain (mint keys, encrypt, seal Node with writeBody, publish, reseal parent)
moveInSharedFolder is fully implemented; client.ts:2360's moveInSharedFolder wrapper is only a stub needing dest-key read-chain resolution wiring

Root cause of full web-e2e suite failure: new-user login path throws 'not implemented — phase 63' when initializing the root vault Node, preventing any test from reaching /files after SIWE login succeeds

workflow: GSD plan-phase gap-closure mode correctly identifies the real live-reachability target when VERIFICATION.md's named stub turns out to be dead code — both planner and independent plan-checker converged on the same substitution, treated as a validated improvement not a deviation

When reusing a running `nest --watch` dev server instead of restarting it, verify it actually reflects current source (e.g. hit a recently-added route and check it 404s vs 401) rather than assuming a stale process — a first test-login 401 turned out to be a transient blip, not a stale-secret issue as initially suspected

Playwright web-e2e failures should be triaged via the error-context.md page snapshot at timeout — it directly showed the 'not implemented — phase 63' alert that explained ~19 cascading waitForURL timeouts, much faster than reading individual spec failures

Before scoping a new phase, run explicit stub-inventory subagents (grep by phase-tag comment, cross-reference against sdk-core to determine wiring vs build) to correctly size effort instead of assuming all stubs are equally tractable
gsd-tools' commit helper has a known false-negative (reports commit_failed while the commit actually lands) — always verify via `git log` rather than retrying the commit

friction: gsd-tools phase-add/insert tooling required trial-and-error (test insert, inspect diff, confirm no renumbering) rather than having documented/predictable behavior

API dev server on :3000 was occupied by a stale 18h-old build; freeing the port caused a `nest --watch` parent to instantly respawn it, requiring inspection of the process tree before deciding whether to fight the watcher or reuse it
docker health-check on the mock-ipns-routing container reported 'unhealthy' while the service was actually responding correctly, requiring a manual health probe to get the truth
Config conflict: auto_advance:true and mode:interactive were simultaneously set, forcing a manual confirmation before launching execute-phase on security-sensitive crypto code

GSD's close_phase_todos step would have wrongly auto-retired 4 open todos tagged resolves_phase:68 that were not actually resolved by this gap closure — required manual frontmatter inspection to catch
open_items: Phase 68.1 'Web Client Runtime Integration' scaffolded (ROADMAP, REQUIREMENTS WEB-01..04, RESEARCH.md, CONTEXT.md) but not yet planned/executed — covers all 46 read+write runtime stubs, gated by full web-e2e suite passing

Two architecture decisions deferred to the 68.1 planner: (1) owned FolderState vs SharedFolderState write-body model reconciliation for owned file create/update; (2) file-vs-folder kind discrimination given SealedChildRef has no kind field
